resolveMany.runtimeDependencyClosure: Two mutually compatible published blobs. The optional resolveMany interface and its helper are exported by scenario-comparison-port; stored-scenarios consumes that type. Other imports already exist. No host, authority, case-port or contract replacement is required for this pair.
preserves: each result is authenticated and reread, including repeated references
initial and final case observations are distinct maps
case grouping includes id, incarnation and producer version
fresh cloned result per output and comparison phase
legacy resolve fallback and a new batch for each later phase
resolveMany.benefitBoundary: Only sibling results with identical stored.caseRef can share a case observation within one phase.

actualMissionLimit.fact: saveCase increments case.version and stores each scenario with that new caseRef. The own helper performs three sequential promotions; the stored producer versions are 2, 3 and 4.
actualMissionLimit.consequence: The baseline/pending and baseline/complete pairs have different group keys. This pair alone does not eliminate their per-case observations and is not proposed as a demonstrated latency fix.

resolveMany.recommendation: DO_NOT_CONSUME_AS_THE_FIX_FOR_THIS_FAILURE. Keep as a bounded published candidate for independent review and separate measured applicability.

selfComparison.relevance: Stored scenario resolution compares the selected Planner source with itself. Published readPair observes an identical source only once per phase, with fresh later phases; the same-source projection is also produced once per read.
selfComparison.limit: The complete published blob also changes financial projection/admission behavior, adds headcount-months/actual-presence dependencies and a scenario qualifier. It must not be installed as a one-file performance patch or copied partially into foreign source without the owner's exact compatible composition and review. No timing improvement is inferred.
